|strategy=By [mailto:arltm@umich.edu Martin Arlt]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/masamedda.html</ref>

[[Mas Amedda]] is a must-have in any Senate package. Besides having high power and politics (which can be further enhanced with [[Stay Here, Where It's Safe]]), he has some excellent game text. First, he'll increase your Force generation when he's with [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum]]. You never know when you'll need that extra Force to deploy a critical character or fire a weapon. Also, when Amedda is in a senate majority, and you control both a battleground site and a battleground system, your opponent loses 2 Force. This is a nice bit of direct damage that bypasses any Force drain modifiers or limiters.

Note that although politically savvy, Amedda is not a senator, and therefore will not be able to be played to your Political Effects. That disadvantage is helped a little by the fact that he can be taken into hand from Reserve by [[Might Of The Republic]].

Combos:

First, Amedda causes 2 Force loss in direct damage, then [[Yarua]] retrieves one Force when you drain at the system.
|combos=* [[Mas Amedda]] + [[Yarua]] + senate majority + [[Control (Coruscant){{!}}Control]] of a battleground site and battleground system First, Amedda causes 2 Force loss in direct damage, then [[Yarua]] retrieves one Force when you drain at the system.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Mas%20Amedda</ref>
